title: Are you okay?
setting: One of you comes home flushed, with work still to finish; the other takes care of them.

lines.jp: {大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}？{顔|かお}が{赤|あか}いよ。
lines.en: Are you okay? Your face is red.

lines.jp: うん…ちょっと{寒|さむ}いんだ。{頭|あたま}も{痛|いた}い。
lines.en: Mm… I feel a bit cold. My head hurts too.

lines.jp: たぶん{風邪|かぜ}でしょう。{今日|きょう}は{早|はや}く{寝|ね}たほうがいいよ。
lines.en: It's probably a cold. You'd better go to bed early tonight.
lines.hint: でしょう = "probably": a fairly confident guess.

lines.jp: でも、{今夜|こんや}このメールを{書|か}かなきゃ。
lines.en: But I have to write this email tonight.
lines.hint: 〜なきゃ is the short, spoken form of 〜なければならない.

lines.jp: じゃあ、お{茶|ちゃ}を{飲|の}みながら{書|か}いて。{温|あたた}かいお{茶|ちゃ}、{入|い}れるね。
lines.en: Then drink some tea while you write it. I'll make you a hot cup.
lines.hint: 〜ながら = while: one person doing two things at once.

lines.jp: ありがとう。{早|はや}く{書|か}いて、すぐ{寝|ね}るね。
lines.en: Thanks. I'll write it quickly and go straight to bed.

lines.jp: うん。{無理|むり}しないでね。お{大事|だいじ}に。
lines.en: Okay. Don't overdo it. Take care of yourself.
